info.title: Cisco DCNM
info.description: Cisco Data Center Network Manager (DCNM) REST API for managing Cisco Nexus data center fabrics, switches, VRFs, networks, interfaces, and policies.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 39 of 364 upstream operations covering fabric read/create/update and config deploy, switch/interface/fabric inventory, interface CRUD and deploy, top-down (v2) network and VRF create/read/update/delete/attach/deploy, policy attach/detach/list, and config template read/create/validate. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.
